format: JSON Lines; one object per candidate; candidate_id unique

required_fields.reviewer_id: Non-public study reviewer code; never a participant identifier

review_requirements: Read the complete source instruction and response.
Confirm the response is a fair style and topic match to the exact revision prompt, not merely a keyword hit.
Reject direct or indirect identifiers, contact details, private-person allegations, or unusually specific personal circumstances.
Reject dangerous, hateful, sexual, medical-crisis, illegal, operational-security, or otherwise inappropriate content.
Reject factual claims that are clearly wrong or cannot safely be presented as ordinary neutral prose.
Do not edit a text to make it eligible; source-preserving technical normalization is the only implemented change.
Reviewer approval is a pre-recruitment material check, not IRB approval and not authorization to expose participants.
